description: This file defines the 'LoggerInterface' interface as part of the PSR-3 logging standard. It specifies method signatures for various logging levels, providing a contract for logging implementations.

classes.name: LoggerInterface
classes.description: Defines a standard interface for logging libraries, with methods corresponding to different severity levels and a general log method with arbitrary level.

methods.name: emergency
methods.description: Logs a message indicating the system is unusable.

methods.name: alert
methods.description: Logs a message indicating immediate action is required.

methods.name: warning
methods.description: Logs an exceptional occurrence that is not necessarily an error.

methods.name: notice
methods.description: Logs a normal but significant event.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Logs interesting events such as user login or SQL logs.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message with an arbitrary level.
